name: Tatara-Rabuga
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Tatara-Rabuga consolidates eastern territories through agreements with agricultural districts and harbour authorities. Control of reserves and flood-safe land tests the limits of royal authority. The University register proposes a connection to Vanga Seed Fleet and Federal Harbour Charter. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
